title: Trick or Treat | Tesla Halloween Mode
summary:
Trick or treaters beware 👻

Enable Trick or Treat in Halloween Mode and your Tesla will play spooky sounds & lights when visitors approach. Rolling out now in an over-the-air software update

To enable:  Toybox → Halloween Mode → Trick or Treat

title: The gripper sucks #bostondynamics  #robot
summary: This gripper sucks—literally. Stretch's vacuum gripper uses individually actuated cups to handle a range of boxes with ease. See what makes the cut, so you can avoid your own frightful freight mismatches this Halloween!
